result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 4 against AC-4.1 through AC-4.4 by reading the story, full tech-design set, test plan, onboarding baseline, and the touched durable-state/store/review/export code paths. I focused on package publication eligibility, current package-context durability and reopen seeding, pinned-version package review/export behavior, and the supporting regression suite plus Story/Epic gates.

newFindings.title: Current package-context reads and writes are exposed as unauthenticated public Convex functions
newFindings.evidence: `convex/processPackageContexts.ts` registers `getCurrentProcessPackageContext` as a public `query` and `clearCurrentProcessPackageContext` / `upsertCurrentProcessPackageContext` as public `mutation` handlers, and `convex/processPackageContextMembers.ts` exposes member enumeration as a public `query`; none of those handlers authenticate callers or validate a service key. `apps/platform/server/services/projects/platform-store.ts` consumes them as server-side store primitives, while the comparable package snapshot publish/read path stays internal-only in `convex/packageSnapshots.ts`. As shipped, anyone who can reach the Convex deployment can read or overwrite another process's mutable package-building context, which breaks the story's process-scoped context guarantee and bypasses the Fastify control-plane boundary.

mockOrShimAuditFindings: No production-path mocks, shims, or fake adapters were introduced in the Story 4 publish/review/export/package-context seams; the in-memory store and fake Convex contexts remain test-only evidence surfaces.
additionalObservations: `verify-all` passed, but the repo's `test:e2e` lane is still scaffold-only and prints a skip message, so integration coverage is the deepest executable end-to-end evidence for this story.
Several Story 4 assertions are traceable by behavior rather than by test title because some package review/export test names still carry stale TC labels from adjacent chunks.
